newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu ready to talk peace once violence stops.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu ready to talk peace once violence stops.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Friday he was ready to negotiate peace with Palestinians once violence stopped.

"We negotiate peace in peaceful means, not in the street, not with Molotov cocktails and not with guns. We negotiate around the table and we are prepared to renew negotiations around the peace table," he told a news conference.
